1.text: Kandi abwira abigishwa be ati “Hariho umutunzi wari ufite igisonga cye, bakimuregaho ko cyaya ibintu bye.

2.text: Aragihamagara arakibwira ati ‘Ibyo nkumvaho ni ibiki? Murikira ibyo nakubikije kuko utagikwiriye kuba igisonga cyanjye.’

3.text: Icyo gisonga kirībwira kiti ‘Ko databuja ari bunyage ubutware bwanjye nkaba ntashobora guhinga, nkagira isoni zo gusabiriza, ndagira nte?

4.text: Have! Nzi icyo nzakora kugira ngo nimara kunyagwa bazandaze mu mazu yabo.’

5.text: “Ahamagara ufite umwenda wa shebuja wese, abaza uwa mbere ati ‘Harya databuja akwishyuza iki?’

6.text: Aramusubiza ati ‘Incuro ijana z'amavuta ya elayo.’ Na we ati ‘Enda urwandiko rwawe, wicare vuba wandike mirongo itanu.’

7.text: Maze abaza undi ati ‘Harya wishyuzwa iki?’ Aramusubiza ati ‘Incuro ijana z'amasaka.’ Aramubwira ati ‘Enda urwandiko rwawe wandike mirongo inani.’

8.text: “Nuko shebuja ashima icyo gisonga kibi kuko cyakoze iby'ubwenge, kuko abana b'iyi si ari abanyabwenge mu byo ku ngoma yabo kuruta abana b'umucyo.

9.text: “Kandi ndababwira nti ‘Ubutunzi bubi mubushakisha incuti, kugira ngo nibushira bazabākīre mu buturo bw'iteka.

10.text: Ukiranuka ku cyoroheje cyane, aba akiranutse no ku gikomeye. Kandi ukiranirwa ku cyoroheje cyane, aba akiraniwe no ku gikomeye.

11.text: Niba mutakiranutse mubikijwe ubutunzi bubi, ni nde uzababitsa ubutunzi bw'ukuri?

12.text: Kandi niba mutakiranutse ku by'abandi mubikijwe, ni nde uzabaha ibyo mwitegekaho?’

13.text: “Nta mugaragu ucyeza abami babiri, kuko aba ashaka kwanga umwe agakunda undi, cyangwa yaguma kuri umwe agasuzugura undi. Ntimubasha gukeza Imana n'ubutunzi.”

14.text: Abafarisayo kuko bari abakunzi b'ubutunzi, bumvise ibyo byose baramukoba cyane.

15.text: Arababwira ati “Mwebwe mukunda kwigira abakiranutsi imbere y'abantu ariko Imana izi imitima yanyu, kuko icyogejwe imbere y'abantu ari ikizira mu maso y'Imana.

16.text: “Amategeko n'abahanuzi byabayeho kugeza igihe cya Yohana, uhereye icyo gihe ni ho ubutumwa bwiza bw'ubwami bw'Imana bwigishirijwe, umuntu wese arabutwaranira.

17.text: Icyoroshye ni uko ijuru n'isi byashira, kuruta ko agace k'inyuguti imwe yo mu mategeko kavaho.

18.text: “Umuntu wese usenda umugore we akarongora undi aba asambanye, kandi n'ucyura umugore usenzwe n'umugabo we aba asambanye.

19.text: “Hariho umutunzi wambaraga imyenda y'imihengeri n'iy'ibitare byiza, iminsi yose agahora adamaraye.

20.text: Kandi hariho n'umukene witwaga Lazaro, wahoraga aryamye ku muryango w'uwo mukire, umubiri we wuzuyeho ibisebe. Imbwa na zo zarazaga zikamurigata mu bisebe,

21.text: kandi yifuzaga guhazwa n'ubuvungukira buva ku meza y'umutunzi.

22.text: “Bukeye umukene arapfa, abamarayika bamujyana mu gituza cya Aburahamu, n'umutunzi na we arapfa arahambwa.

23.text: Ageze ikuzimu arababazwa cyane, yubuye amaso areba Aburahamu ari kure na Lazaro ari mu gituza cye.

24.text: Arataka ati ‘Aburahamu sogokuru, mbabarira wohereze Lazaro, akoze isonga y'urutoki rwe mu tuzi antonyangirize ku rurimi, kuko mbabazwa n'uyu muriro.’

25.text: “Aburahamu aramubwira ati ‘Mwana wanjye, ibuka yuko wahawe ibyiza byawe ukiriho. Lazaro na we yahawe ibibi, none aguwe neza hano naho wowe urababazwa cyane.

26.text: Kandi uretse n'ibyo, dore hariho umworera munini bikabije hagati yacu namwe, washyiriweho kugira ngo abashaka kuva hano kuza aho muri batabibasha, kandi n'abava aho batagera hano.’

27.text: Na we ati ‘Ndakwinginze sogokuru ngo nibura umwohereze kwa data,

28.text: kuko mfite bene data batanu, ababurire ngo na bo batazaza aha hantu ho kubabarizwa cyane.’

30.text: Na we ati ‘Oya sogokuru Aburahamu, ahubwo nihagira uzuka akabasanga bazīhana.’

31.text: Aramubwira ati ‘Nibatumvira Mose n'abahanuzi, ntibakwemera naho umuntu yazuka.’ ”
